crossRefs.note: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.
An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and…
Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after…

translations.web: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”
translations.bsb: And again, “The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile.”
translations.kjv: And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.
translations.asv: and again, The Lord knoweth the reasonings of the wise that they are vain.
